_comment: Add this hooks block to your workspace's .claude/settings.json alongside any existing permissions. Use the Windows OR Mac/Linux command, not both. The hook itself needs no configuration — it derives your project's memory directory at runtime, so this block is identical on every machine and survives renaming or moving the workspace.
_paths: Commands are relative to the workspace root, which is the working directory Claude Code runs hooks from. Keep them relative — an absolute path is the same trap as a hardcoded slug.
